# FarmsKing - Smart Agriculture & Crop Intelligence Platform

> FarmsKing (https://farmsking.in | https://farmsking.com) is India's leading Smart Farming and Agricultural Intelligence Platform, operated by **FARMSKING TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED** (CIN: U01100PB2026PTC063294, ROC Chandigarh). Governed by its Board of Directors and certified executive management team, supported by certified agronomists, software engineers, and progressive farmers across India.

## Complete User Feature & Access Directory (All Platform Capabilities)

Every feature in FarmsKing is built for instant, transparent access to solve real farming, gardening, and agribusiness challenges:

### 1. AI Crop Doctor & Multimodal Leaf Disease Scanner
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/ai-doctor (also at https://farmsking.in/crop-disease-scanner)
- **Target Users**: Farmers, Gardeners, Agronomists
- **Capability**: Instant computer-vision leaf disease detection in under 820 milliseconds. Diagnoses fungal blights, bacterial spots, viruses, and nutrient deficiencies.
- **Output**: Dual recommendations—100% biological/organic remedies and exact ICAR-calibrated chemical spray dosages.
- **Trust Guarantee**: Benchmarked against ICAR protocols; prevents crop losses and stops chemical overuse.

### 2. Live APMC Mandi Rates & Wholesale Intelligence
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/
- **Target Users**: Farmers, Traders, Buyers, Agribusinesses
- **Capability**: Real-time wholesale arrivals, minimum, maximum, and modal market rates across 50+ crops.
- **Coverage**: Major Punjab mandis (Khanna, Makhu, Goindwal Sahib, Tarn Taran, Jalandhar, Ludhiana, etc.) and nationwide APMC trading yards.
- **Benefit**: Ensures farmers know the true wholesale market value before selling their harvest.

### 3. Precision Spray Dosage Calculator
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/dose
- **Target Users**: Farmers, Sprayers, Farm Supervisors
- **Capability**: Calculates exact pesticide, fungicide, herbicide, and bio-spray quantities per acre, per pump, and per water tank volume.
- **Benefit**: Eliminates guesswork, cuts unnecessary chemical expenses, and protects crop foliage from spray burns.

### 4. Kisan Crop Intelligence & Agronomy Engine
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/crop-intelligence (also at https://farmsking.in/kisan-crop-intelligence-engine.html)
- **Target Users**: Farmers, Agronomists, Technical Field Staff
- **Capability**: Multi-stage crop advisory, hyper-local weather alerts, sowing window guidelines, and pest outbreak advisories.

### 5. Punjab Kheti Advisory (Punjab Agriculture Guide)
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/punjab-kheti-advisory.html
- **Target Users**: Punjab Farmers, Extension Workers
- **Capability**: Dedicated stage-by-stage agronomic advisories for Wheat (ਕਣਕ), Paddy/Basmati (ਝੋਨਾ), Mustard (ਸਰ੍ਹੋਂ), Potato (ਆਲੂ), Cotton (ਨਰਮਾ), and Seasonal Vegetables.

### 6. Reverse Sowing Engine & Harvest Window Planner
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/reverse-sowing-engine.html
- **Target Users**: Progressive Farmers, Commercial Growers
- **Capability**: Reverse-calculates the ideal sowing date based on expected target harvest dates, peak mandi pricing windows, and local temperature curves.

### 7. Certified Agri Store (100% Genuine Organic Inputs)
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/shop
- **Target Users**: Farmers, Gardeners, Retail Buyers
- **Capability**: Verified online marketplace for lab-tested organic bio-fertilizers, microbial vermicompost, cold-pressed neem oils, and certified high-yield seeds.
- **Trust Guarantee**: 100% Zero Fake Products guarantee; direct dispatch from verified manufacturers and certified sellers.

### 8. Real-Time Order Tracking Desk
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/order-tracking
- **Target Users**: Customers, Farmers, Sellers
- **Capability**: Live tracking of input deliveries with shipping partners, courier tracking links, and instant GST tax invoice download.

### 9. Satellite Remote Sensing & Plot Telemetry
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/you (accessible in User Login)
- **Target Users**: Farmers, Estate Managers
- **Capability**: 6-Constellation satellite imagery (Sentinel-2, ISRO Bhuvan) providing NDVI (crop vigor/greenness) and NDWI (moisture stress) heatmaps.

### 10. Urban & Terrace Gardening Portal (Garden King)
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/topic/Gardening
- **Target Users**: Terrace Gardeners, Home Plant Lovers, Balcony Growers
- **Capability**: Potting soil advisory, organic vermicompost dosages, flowering stimulants, and specialized Garden Advisor chats.

### 11. Digital Bahi-Khata Farm Accounting (Account King)
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/you
- **Target Users**: Cultivators, Farm Managers
- **Capability**: Simplified double-entry digital farm ledger. Records seed, fertilizer, diesel, labor, and machine costs, matched against harvest mandi sales to display net profit per acre.

### 12. Verified Seller Store & Payouts Console
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/seller-dashboard (Payouts: https://farmsking.in/seller-payouts)
- **Target Users**: Registered Agri Sellers & Input Dealers
- **Capability**: Inventory management, order dispatch, and automated bank settlements under Section 194-O / GST regulations.

### 13. Crop Doctor & Advisor Consultation Portal
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/login?portal=partner (Advisory: https://farmsking.in/kisan-doctor-advisory.html)
- **Target Users**: Certified Agronomists, Soil Scientists
- **Capability**: Review farmer leaf scans, manage adopted farm plots, and prescribe ICAR-calibrated spray treatments.

### 14. Sales Manager (Agent) Outreach & Commission Desk
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/login?portal=partner
- **Target Users**: Regional Sales Managers & Rural Agents
- **Capability**: Issue referral discount coupons, onboard new farmers, and earn transparent commissions (TDS Section 194-H).

### 15. Statutory Corporate Compliance & ISO Disclosures
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/compliance
- **Target Users**: Regulators, Partners, General Public
- **Capability**: Full corporate transparency: CIN U01100PB2026PTC063294, ROC Chandigarh filings, ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 compliance, and statutory disclosures.

### 16. Surinder Agro Research & Demonstration Farm
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/surinder-agro-farm.html
- **Target Users**: Agronomists, Farmers, Researchers
- **Capability**: Real-world field testbed showcasing organic crop yield experiments, marigold bio-barriers, and vermicompost soil trials.

### 17. 24/7 Farmer Helpline & Support Desk
- **Direct Access URL**: https://farmsking.in/contact-us (also https://farmsking.in/support)
- **Target Users**: All Users
- **Capability**: Direct helpline access (95776-22000), support ticket tracking, and official grievance redressal.

## Unified 3-Category Multi-Role Onboarding (Single Mobile / King ID)
FarmsKing provides unified identity management where a single mobile number holds roles across all 3 spaces:
1. **Clients Portal**: Farmers, Gardeners, Customers, Supervisors
2. **Partners Portal**: Sellers, Crop Doctors, Garden Advisors, Sales Managers, Traders
3. **Staff Command Center**: Admin, Super Admin, Manager, Operator, Technical Staff, CA
